title: 1:1 prep - Avery Brooks / Morgan Chen
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with Morgan Chen
Date: 2026-02-27 (30 min)
Location: Zoom / async notes in Drive

Objective:
- Sync on current priorities and unblock anything blocking delivery for the next sprint.
- Quick career check-in and roadmap alignment.
- Review on-call fatigue and follow-up on action items from last 1:1.

Agenda (proposed):
1) Quick wins / wins since last 1:1 (2-3 min)
   - Ship small perf fix to KV cache that reduced tail latency in dev cluster (PR #812) — ask Morgan for brief summary and any rollout concerns.
2) Current blockers (8-10 min)
   - INF-4821: batching regression on long-context models causing ~15% throughput drop for 2K+ sequences. Need to decide revert vs patch.
   - Infra flakiness: node eviction in dedicated pool when GPU driver OOMs — Morgan noted increased incident rate on m60-2.
   - Ask: what prevents you from shipping the INF-4821 patch today? Dependencies? Test coverage?
3) Priorities for next sprint (8 min)
   - Finish batching regression fix, add focused microbenchmarks (owner: Morgan).
   - Start rollout plan for KV cache latency fix across dedicated (canary -> region-fallback). Need an ops playbook.
   - Decide on pairing with QA for stress tests next week.
4) Career / growth (6 min)
   - Discuss interest in tech lead stretch: identify two cross-team projects to own (suggested: batching performance work + KV cache rollout).
   - Feedback loop: ask Morgan how supported they feel and what they need to take a lead.
5) Admin / on-call / well-being (2-3 min)
   - On-call load last 2 weeks: 3 pager incidents, cumulative overtime ~9 hours. Consider rebalancing.
   - Time off planned: Morgan mentioned week of 2026-03-15 — confirm coverage plan.
6) Action items & quick wrap (1-2 min)

Notes / prompts for me (Avery):
- Start meeting by acknowledging the KV cache perf improvement — small wins matter.
- Be explicit on scope: ask Morgan which tests would prove the batching fix is safe for rollouts.
- If Morgan is hesitant to lead rollout, offer to pair with Product Ops to draft the runbook.
- Probe for blockers that are cross-team (observability, infra) and commit to escalating in the SRE sync.

Background context (for reference):
- INF-4821 created 2026-02-20 after we saw a throughput regression in nightly perf runs. Morgan reproduced locally and has a candidate patch. CI flaky on long sequences (test L2-L4 failing intermittently).
- PR #812 (kv cache tail latency fix) merged to main 2026-02-18; canary showed small improvements; need canary->gradual rollout plan.
- Recent incident notes: node eviction on dedicated pool logged on 2026-02-22 (INC-2026-02-22-03) — SRE investigating driver OOM triggers.

Action items (from last 1:1) and status:
- Morgan: add microbench for 2k+ sequences (status: in progress, branch perf/microbench, ETA 2026-03-01).
- Avery: escalate infra evictions with SRE and schedule post-mortem (status: done, PMR scheduled).
- Both: draft rollout playbook for kv-cache (status: partial — playbook outline in Confluence, needs ops runbook).

New action items (decisions to capture):
- Morgan -> finish INF-4821 patch + tests; create PR and request review from two peers. (owner: Morgan, due: 2026-03-03)
- Avery -> if PR looks risky, coordinate temporary quota-limited canary and prepare rollback plan (owner: Avery, due: 2026-03-04)
- Morgan + QA -> schedule stress test run for batching scenarios (owner: Morgan, cc: QA, due: 2026-03-05)
- Avery -> raise infra evictions in SRE weekly and ask for timeline to resolution (owner: Avery, due: 2026-03-02)
- Morgan -> update Confluence runbook for KV cache rollout with steps, metrics to watch, and rollback signals (owner: Morgan, due: 2026-03-06)

Risks / escalation notes:
- If INF-4821 patch increases token cost by adding extra scheduling overhead, product may push back — flag to product team early.
- If driver OOMs continue, we may need to pause dedicated fleet rollouts; escalate to infra leadership.

Kudos / positive notes:
- Morgan: great attention to detail on the KV cache latency patch and for triaging CI flakes quickly.
- Team: good cross-team response on incident; SRE + infra coordinated well.

Follow-up items for next 1:1:
- Review PR and canary metrics (latency p95/p99, throughput, token cost)
- Check on Morgan's readiness to take on tech lead stretch; propose a concrete small project to lead by next month.
- Confirm on-call load after rebalancing and impact on personal time off.

Quick questions to ask Morgan in the meeting:
- What would make you comfortable releasing the INF-4821 fix today?
- Any blockers on getting test coverage for long-context sequences?
- Do you want me to pair with you on the rollout playbook or assign to Product Ops?
- How is your bandwidth for taking a tech lead stretch this quarter?

Notes to self after meeting (fill in during/after):
- Decisions made: 
- New blockers found: 
- Commitments recorded:
summary_line: 30m 1:1 — unblock INF-4821 batching regression, finalize KV cache rollout runbook, career stretch conversation
